title: The Generalized Semi-Clifford Conjecture Holds at Level 4
summary: The Clifford hierarchy $\mathsf{C}_1 \subset \mathsf{C}_2 \subset \cdots$ was introduced by Gottesman and Chuang (arXiv:quant-ph/9908010) to characterize gates that admit fault-tolerant implementation by gate teleportation. Yet, despite its rich mathematical structure and the attention it has received in recent years, little is known about $\mathsf{C}_k$ for $k > 3$. Most progress has focused on identifying structural properties of restrictions of the hierarchy, such as diagonal gates and gates on systems of small dimension $d$ or with few qudits.
